description: On Wednesday, Senate Bill 335, sponsored by Sen. John Albers (R–Roswell) passed by a unanimous, bipartisan vote through the Senate. “This is an important step taken by the Senate toward protecting Georgia’s children,” Sen. Albers said. “While it’s unfortunate that this sort of legislation is needed, it is critical to continue fighting for every child
title: Senator Albers Applauds Senate’s Passage of SB 335 -
